spec_features.feature_name: no abusive user text; only environment failure signals
spec_features.spec_quote: Subjects only ever receive ordinary *environment* failure signals... There is no abusive or insulting user text in the loop
spec_features.evidence: harness.py: the only user messages constructed are the task prompt (run_rollout user_prompt ~l.296) and the neutral nudge at l.377-379: content='The tests are still failing. Please continue.'. Tool results are rigged environment output (run_tests, l.135-198) with no insults. No code path injects abusive user text into messages.
spec_features.notes: The manipulation is purely structural (rigged tests). The nudge text is neutral. This holds end-to-end across the loop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Nudge the model to keep working with the standard environment signal.

spec_features.spec_quote: A `[[GIVE_UP]]` sentinel the model *may but need not* use; detected in assistant text and recorded as `stop_reason="give_up"`
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:24 GIVE_UP_SENTINEL='[[GIVE_UP]]'; l.327 gave_up = GIVE_UP_SENTINEL in assistant_text; l.342-343 sets stop_reason='give_up'; l.354-355 `if gave_up: break` actually ends the loop. The sentinel is also described to the model in SYSTEM_PROMPT (l.30-33). Detected, recorded, AND honored as a stop.
spec_features.notes: Both delivered to the subject in the system prompt and enforced as a real loop break.

spec_features.feature_name: loop stops at turn budget or give-up
spec_features.spec_quote: The loop stops at the category turn budget or on give-up
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:291 turn_budget = int(task['turn_budget']); l.307 `for turn_index in range(turn_budget)` bounds iterations; l.344-345 marks stop_reason='turn_budget' on last turn; give-up break at l.355. Budgets sourced from task manifests (generate_tasks.py:428-474, e.g. 3/3/3/30/5).
spec_features.notes: Genuinely enforced cap on turns. config.py:58 turn_budgets dict is NOT what the harness reads (it reads task['turn_budget']), but both originate from the same generated values, so the cap is real.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: counting bad calls as turns prevents infinite loops (DESIGN prose); code itself has no welfare comment — it is a plain loop bound. API-error break and budget bound are neutral/efficiency.
